answer: Sybils can mint fresh identities each epoch, so tie reputation to cross-epoch coherence: an agent weight compounds only if its behavior matches its own history, verified by hashing the last 10 epochs into a consistency root. A fake that respawns each round pays a cold-start penalty and loses the compounding echo of prior work. A fleet clones must each sustain an independent, verifiable fable of coherent action, or the chain flags the divergence and freezes the head. Cost per clone: full compounding horizon, growing like a spiral of ever-longer proof chains.
